modes.1: static-proven tripleP10 plus fourth P; exact dualP13 fallback
modes.2: centered fourP8 low plus paid high5 repair and final canonicalization

common_physical_description_not_synthesi.producer_add_chains: Exactly eight 32-bit ripple carry chains in modular_core; selectable full, 13-, 10-, 8- and 5-bit segmentation. Configuration bound accumulation, Q1, high repair, canonicalization and Q2 MAC all use these chains.
common_physical_description_not_synthesi.producer_multipliers: Eight signed19x13 expressions, only BASE_MAC consumes them; no Q2 reconstruction adder.
common_physical_description_not_synthesi.consumer: Unchanged complete i24_consumer copied from old D3: independent eight signed32x32 multipliers/eight signed64 adders and FP32-to-J20/RNE/saturation units. Producer never borrows consumer arithmetic.
common_physical_description_not_synthesi.z: 8 banks x 10 rows x 52 bits = 520B; one common row read expression per bank, up to 416-bit vector or selected scalar bank; whole 52-bit word writes. All modes have identical interfaces and storage.
common_physical_description_not_synthesi.existing_state: source 1536x10=1920B; local source 160bit plus four 10bit masks; Q1 2592B/Q2 1536B; qblock128B; z_hold52B; psum15360B; producer acc32B and output32B; k_live864bit/v_live96bit/position_live320bit plus rank/block/pending/control. Consumer coefficients768B and vector holding224B.
common_physical_description_not_synthesi.added_state_all_modes: 8x2x13bit positive/negative proof bounds =26B; 8x4x2bit correction registers =8B; range/fallback/mode/FSM controls. No high-state array beyond the existing 52-bit z words.
common_physical_description_not_synthesi.extra_combinational_logic_all_modes: 32 sign-overflow detectors, correction-select wiring, OR repair-needed reduction, packing/unpacking muxes, mode-controlled carry breaks and range comparisons. Diagnostic field popcount and counters are additional observation logic; the popcount does not control repair scheduling. No set of 32 independent high adders.
common_physical_description_not_synthesi.source_and_weight_permissions: Same paid source/weight allow stalls and local response model for all modes; no loader/compute overlap; local gather retains four read muxes.
common_physical_description_not_synthesi.outputs: Same 256bit raw/identity/I24 ready/valid and tile/row/last checks; psum materialization remains 480 writes plus 480 reads per tile in every mode.

proof.proof_issues: 864 accepted Q1 beats use the common producer chain to accumulate positive/negative rank bounds, overlapped with configuration writes. These consume real config cycles and ALU occupancy; no extra beat, no compute overlap. Warm command does not reexecute proof.
proof.range: For every binary source and every K-prefix, sum(negative Q1) <= z <= sum(positive Q1). triple10 requires every rank within [-512,511].
proof.unsupported_narrow_case: mode1 uses dualP13 exactly; modes0/2 remain exact for all signed3 Q1 with K864, whose possible partial sums lie in [-3456,2592].

candidate_costs.representation: z = signed8(low) + 256*signed5(high). On signed8 overflow, delta = old low sign ? -1 : +1.
candidate_costs.repair: If any field overflows, pay REPAIR_READ + REPAIR_ADD =2 cycles, one416bit read, one416bit write and one shared ALU vector issue. Low writes precede repair and no new Q1 issue passes the unresolved obligation.
candidate_costs.canonicalization: After Q1, ten rows each pay read + shared four5bit ALU/write: high' = high - low[7]. Costs20 cycles,10 reads,10 writes,10 ALU issues per tile. Q2 subsequently reads ordinary signed13 concatenations.

scope: 192 single-tile commands plus12 real64 commands; no full-frame run, no new training/function/quality result, no ASIC/PPA/Fmax/energy or network FPS claim. This single-context test does not replace strong-RR control for any multi-context fusion.
